answer_1.quote: We generate high-quality synthetic data by prompting an LLM to generate text x that expresses these, and only these, triplets ...
answer_1.outputs: natural language sentences that faithfully express a given set of structured (subject, relation, object) triplets

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the match between the triplet‑set‑to‑text pairs for each dataset by scoring data points in terms of standard precision, recall, and F1 ...

answer_4.quote: We ran the inference on a selected set of 12 triplet sets ... manually evaluated the quality of the generated outputs in terms of precision, recall, and fluency. Human annotators (MTurk workers and hired Ph.D./MSc students) were asked to select which triplets are expressed in the sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were presented with a sentence and a list of candidate triplets and instructed to mark the triplets that are actually expressed in the sentence.
